targetTexts.1: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates correction is stupid.
targetTexts.2: The good man obtains favor from the LORD, but the LORD condemns a man who devises evil.
targetTexts.3: A man cannot be established through wickedness, but the righteous cannot be uprooted.
targetTexts.4: A wife of noble character is her husband’s crown, but she who causes shame is like decay in his bones.
targetTexts.5: The plans of the righteous are just, but the counsel of the wicked leads to deceit.
targetTexts.6: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
targetTexts.7: The wicked are overthrown and perish, but the house of the righteous will stand.
targetTexts.8: A man is praised according to his wisdom, but a twisted mind is despised.
targetTexts.9: Better to be lightly esteemed yet have a servant, than to be self-important but lack food.
targetTexts.10: A righteous man regards the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are only cruelty.
targetTexts.11: The one who works his land will have plenty of food, but whoever chases fantasies lacks judgment.
targetTexts.12: The wicked desire the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
targetTexts.13: An evil man is trapped by his rebellious speech, but a righteous man escapes from trouble.
targetTexts.14: By fruitful speech a man is filled with good things, and the work of his hands returns to him.
targetTexts.15: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but a wise man listens to counsel.
targetTexts.16: A fool’s anger is known at once, but a prudent man overlooks an insult.
targetTexts.17: He who speaks the truth declares what is right, but a false witness speaks deceit.
targetTexts.18: Speaking rashly is like a piercing sword, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
targetTexts.19: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
targetTexts.20: Deceit is in the hearts of those who devise evil, but the counselors of peace have joy.
targetTexts.21: No harm befalls the righteous, but the wicked are filled with trouble.
targetTexts.22: Lying lips are detestable to the LORD, but those who deal faithfully are His delight.
targetTexts.23: A shrewd man keeps his knowledge to himself, but a foolish heart proclaims its folly.
targetTexts.24: The hand of the diligent will rule, but laziness ends in forced labor.
targetTexts.25: Anxiety weighs down the heart of a man, but a good word cheers it up.
targetTexts.26: A righteous man is cautious in friendship, but the ways of the wicked lead them astray.
targetTexts.27: A lazy man does not roast his game, but a diligent man prizes his possession.
targetTexts.28: There is life in the path of righteousness, but another path leads to death.
